name: Angkor Wat International Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon and multi-distance race held at the Angkor Wat temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia on December 6, 2026.
ai_summary: The Angkor Wat International Half Marathon is scheduled for December 6, 2026, taking place at the iconic Angkor Wat temple complex within Angkor Archaeological Park in Siem Reap, Cambodia. Organized by the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia together with the Athletics Federation of Cambodia, the event offers four distances: 21.1km, 10km, 5km, and 3km. Registration has not yet been announced.

faqs.question: When is the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Angkor Wat International Half Marathon is scheduled to take place on December 6, 2026. The race is held at the Angkor Wat temple complex within Angkor Archaeological Park, located in Siem Reap, Cambodia, drawing runners to one of the country's most iconic historical landmarks.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: The event offers four distance options for participants to choose from: a 21.1km half marathon, which is the primary distance, along with shorter races of 10km, 5km, and 3km. This range allows runners of varying experience and fitness levels to take part.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The race is organized jointly by the National Olympic Committee of Cambodia and the Athletics Federation of Cambodia. These organizations oversee the planning and execution of the event, which takes place at the historic Angkor Wat temple complex in Siem Reap, Cambodia.

faqs.question: Can I register for the race now?
faqs.answer: Registration for the Angkor Wat International Half Marathon has not yet been announced. At this time, there is no confirmed sign-up process or opening date available, so prospective participants will need to wait for further updates from the organizers regarding registration.
